query: SELECT d.pid AS "deal_pid!", e.campaign_pid AS "campaign_pid!", e.sent_at AS "at!" FROM deals d JOIN email_deliveries e ON e.contact_pid = d.primary_contact_pid WHERE d.pid IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)::uuid) AND $3::bool AND e.state = 'sent' AND e.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND e.sent_at <= d.closed_at AND e.sent_at >= d.closed_at - make_interval(days => $2::int) UNION ALL SELECT d.pid, e.campaign_pid, ev.received_at FROM deals d JOIN email_deliveries e ON e.contact_pid = d.primary_contact_pid JOIN email_events ev ON ev.message_id = e.message_id WHERE d.pid IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)::uuid) AND ev.event IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($4::jsonb)) AND ($5::int = 0 OR ev.event <> 'opened' OR ev.received_at >= e.sent_at + make_interval(secs => $5::int)) AND ($6::int = 0 OR ev.event <> 'clicked' OR ev.received_at >= e.sent_at + make_interval(secs => $6::int)) AND ev.received_at <= d.closed_at AND ev.received_at >= d.closed_at - make_interval(days => $2::int) UNION ALL SELECT d.pid, l.campaign_pid, l.created_at FROM deals d JOIN leads l ON l.contact_pid = d.primary_contact_pid WHERE d.pid IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb)::uuid) AND l.campaign_pid IS NOT NULL AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.created_at <= d.closed_at AND l.created_at >= d.closed_at - make_interval(days => $2::int)
